skill.displayName: Identifying companies via LinkedIn, locating businesses from LinkedIn data by name,industry, size, and founding year. Helping sales teams, marketers, and B2B lead-generationspecialists discover LinkedIn company profiles, research target clients, and enrichfirmographic data—suitable for customer acquisition, market research, competitor analysis,and account-based sales.

llm.summary: This skill is review-worthy because it enables paid LinkedIn company and contact-data searches while using a local plaintext API key file without enough privacy or secret-handling guardrails.

dimensions.detail: The stated company-search and market-research purpose is coherent, but the documented API includes email, phone, WhatsApp, social, and employee-contact discovery, including bulk-style examples up to 1000 records, which makes the data-use impact sensitive.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill gives fee-confirmation steps and tells the agent to wait before paid calls, but it does not provide privacy, consent, lawful-use, retention, or anti-harvesting boundaries for contact and employee-contact data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The submitted artifact contains only Markdown documentation and no executable scripts or requirements file, despite instructions to run Python scripts; no hidden installer or destructive install behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Python, network API access, and an UpKuaJing API key are proportionate for an API-backed search skill, but users should understand that queries go to an external paid service and may return contact-related data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs use of a persistent plaintext credential file at ~/.upkuajing/.env and even shows catting that file, without explicit safeguards against printing, logging, or pasting the API key into chat.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Review before installing if you will use real lead or employee-contact data. Use a dedicated API key, do not paste or display the key in chat or logs, confirm paid calls before they run, and only use contact-data features where you have authorization and a lawful basis.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Verified in the artifact: contact-data filters and person_contact_show are documented. Contact filtering fits the lead-generation purpose, but the missing privacy and acceptable-use guidance makes this a material Review concern.
[PE3] expected: Verified in the artifact: an API key is expected for this service, but the setup instructions rely on ~/.upkuajing/.env and do not clearly prevent exposing the key during setup or troubleshooting.
[suspicious.exposed_secret_literal] unexpected: Downgraded as a static-scan false positive: the cited text references the UPKUAJING_API_KEY variable and auth.py command, not an actual hardcoded secret.
